answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 7 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. The summit multiplier is published, charged in ivory, and karst lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, as the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 4693 identities would post 1233 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
